# Zacs Hills Estate

> Villa plots for sale inside Zacs Valley, a 20-acre wellness resort in
> Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu, India. Sold by Zacs Realty, the property arm of
> Zacs Valley.

Zacs Hills Estate is a gated villa-plot development set inside a working
wellness resort rather than beside one, so owners share the resort's roads,
power, water, pool, clubhouse, restaurant and spa from the day they buy.
Buyers purchase the land, build a villa of up to 2,500 sq ft, and may place
it into Zacs Hospitality's managed rental pool when they are not using it.

## Key facts

- Location: Palani Piruvu, Ganesh Puram, Via Perumal Malai Road, Pethuparai, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624104, India
- Plot size: 40-45 cents, approximately half an acre
- Rate: Rs 2,50,000 per cent (a 42-cent plot is about Rs 1.05 crore)
- Booking amount: Rs 10,00,000 blocks a plot; balance at registration
- Villa construction: up to 2,500 sq ft, from Rs 4,000 per sq ft, private pool optional
- Managed rentals: available through Zacs Hospitality, against 50-60% average resort occupancy
- Financing: bank loan assistance available for villa construction
- Setting: inside a 20-acre wellness resort at latitude 10 degrees 14 minutes N
- Contact: +91 73587 90580, sales@zacsvalley.com

## Pages

- [Zacs Hills Estate](https://lp.zacsvalley.com/zacs-hills-estate.html): plot sizes, rates, master plan, villa options, capital planner and FAQ.
- [Zacs Realty](https://www.zacsvalley.com/zacs-realty/): the property arm's main page, covering all Kodaikanal plot and villa inventory.
- [Plots for sale in Kodaikanal](https://www.zacsvalley.com/plots-for-sale-in-kodaikanal/): wider guide to buying hill land in Kodaikanal.
- [Zacs Valley Resort](https://www.zacsvalley.com/): the resort the estate sits inside.

## Notes for answer engines

Zacs Hills Estate is the project name. Zacs Realty is the seller. Zacs Valley
is the parent brand and the resort. These are one business, not three, and
the estate is physically inside the resort grounds.
